mainEntity.name: Can I move my 123FormBuilder forms to Formester?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no one-click importer, but the move is quick: export your submissions to Excel or CSV from 123FormBuilder while your plan is active, then rebuild each form in Formester by pasting the question list into the AI generator or describing the form in a sentence. Most forms rebuild in minutes.

mainEntity.name: Does Formester charge extra for payment collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Stripe and PayPal payment fields are included on the free plan. Standard processor fees from Stripe or PayPal still apply, but Formester adds no platform fee and no plan gate. At 123FormBuilder, payment gateways start on the Platinum plan at $49 a month.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Formester for HIPAA workloads?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant, and does not hold HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 certification. If you collect protected health information, 123FormBuilder's Enterprise Compliance plan with a BAA or Jotform's Gold and Enterprise plans are the safer homes for that workload.

Not natively. Formester connects to HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Slack natively, and reaches Salesforce through Zapier, n8n, or webhooks. If deep native Salesforce forms are your requirement, that is a genuine 123FormBuilder strength.

mainEntity.name: What is the MCP server and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: MCP lets AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT read your form submissions directly, so you can ask questions of your data instead of exporting it. Formester ships an MCP server on the Business plan. 123FormBuilder advertises no equivalent.

mainEntity.name: How do the paid plans compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester runs $13 a month for Personal and $49 for Business, both with unlimited forms and responses. 123FormBuilder lists Gold at $37, Platinum at $49, and Diamond at $99 a month, with yearly billing currently halving those figures, and volume caps on each tier. Payments need Platinum there; they are free here.

Payments sit two tiers up, at $49

Collecting money through a form requires the Platinum plan. The 15+ payment gateways in their own feature matrix start there, not on Free and not on Gold.

Costs climb tier by tier

G2 reviewers describe advanced features reserved for premium subscriptions that quickly increase the cost. The list-price ladder runs $37, $49, $99, then $225 per user for Enterprise.

The builder feels dated and rigid

Recurring G2 complaints: limited design flexibility, custom layouts that fight back, and occasional bugs. One reviewer calls it a very outdated tool next to newer builders.

Migration

How do you switch from 123FormBuilder to Formester?

Three steps. Your submissions come with you, and the rebuild is the fast part.

1

Export your 123FormBuilder submissions

Open each form's Submissions view and export to Excel or CSV. Do it while your paid plan is active: import and export of submissions is a paid feature in their matrix, so grab copies before you downgrade.

2

Rebuild each form with AI

Paste the field list into Formester's AI generator or describe the form in a sentence. It drafts the fields, pages, and design in about half a minute; you adjust wording and branding, then re-add any logic rules.

Input options: plain prompt, pasted question list, or PDF upload.

Swap the 123FormBuilder embed for Formester's snippet, publish the share link, and connect Stripe or PayPal if you collect payments. Send one test submission, then retire the old form once the numbers match.

Safety net: keep the old form live for a week as a fallback.

Honest comparison

When is 123FormBuilder still the better choice?

Formester is not the answer for every team. Four cases where staying put is the right call.

You handle patient data under HIPAA

123FormBuilder holds the certifications regulated healthcare buyers ask for.

  • Certified HIPAA compliance with a BAA on the Enterprise Compliance plan ($255 per user/mo, billed yearly)
  • ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, with AWS data residency in the US and Europe
  • Formester is not HIPAA certified, and we say so plainly
  • Compensating controls in place: encryption in transit and at rest, annual third-party penetration testing, enforced 2FA, and encrypted backups

Choose 123FormBuilder when PHI collection is the job

Your forms live inside Salesforce

Their Salesforce integration goes deeper than most form builders attempt.

  • Native Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud integration on Enterprise
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud from the Diamond plan
  • Formester reaches Salesforce only through Zapier or webhooks

Choose 123FormBuilder if Salesforce is your system of record

You need enterprise data-collection governance

Owned by Kiteworks since 2024, with the contract structure large orgs expect.

  • SLA, dedicated account manager, and custom contracts on Enterprise
  • SSO available as an Enterprise add-on
  • Data residency choices in the US and Europe

Choose 123FormBuilder for procurement-heavy enterprise rollouts

You want a huge template head start

Their template library is one of the largest in the category.

  • 3,000+ ready-made form templates
  • Template categories across industries and use cases
  • Formester's library is smaller and leans on AI generation instead

Choose 123FormBuilder if you build from templates, not prompts

Privacy and data ownership

Your form data is yours. We don't train on it

Everything that moves through your forms is Customer Data: the prompts you type, the structures the AI drafts, and every response a respondent submits. Section 4.4 of our Data Processing Addendum bars Formester from using any of it to train AI models, run advertising, or feed analytics and marketing. The Google Gemini integration that drafts forms works inside the same boundary.

Responses travel over TLS, sit encrypted at rest, and payment data gets an extra AES-256 layer through Stripe. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified, and the security page says exactly that instead of hinting otherwise.

"Formester shall not use Customer Data for purposes of analytics, advertising, marketing, or training of artificial intelligence or machine learning models, except as strictly necessary to provide the Services."
